BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.title: Simple Rune
BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all your basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.title: Hunter's Blade
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [red]Tender[/red].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.flavor: Crafted using the shell of a mighty bug. Wears easily then repairs itself.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.title: Inklet Shawl
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Slip[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. If you have [gold]Slippery[/gold] at the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.flavor: Comfortable and fashionable, although wearers eventually find it consumes them.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.title: Elegant Rune
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [red]Downgrade[/red] [blue]{DowngradeNum}[/blue] random cards.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.flavor: The answer was elegance. Of course.
BAGELSMOD-PHANTASMAL_ARMOR.title: Phantasmal Armor
BAGELSMOD-PHANTASMAL_ARMOR.description: The first time you take unblocked damage each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {BlurPower} [gold]Blur[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-PHANTASMAL_ARMOR.flavor: Armor that wraps around the wearer at the first sign of danger.
BAGELSMOD-BITING_BRACE.title: Biting Brace
BAGELSMOD-BITING_BRACE.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Whenever you take unblocked attack damage, lose [blue]{MaxHp:diff()}[/blue] Max HP.
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.title: Shattering Crystal
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to [purple]{Cards:diff()}[/purple] [gold]Attacks[/gold] or [gold]Skills[/gold] with [gold]Fragile[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.flavor: Perpetually locked in a state of almost breaking.
BAGELSMOD-WRITHING_TONGS.title: Writhing Tongs
BAGELSMOD-WRITHING_TONGS.flavor: These cursed tongs shift in your hand, but they seem at peace.
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.title: Blessed Cauldron
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.description: Procure a [gold]Moment of Clarity[/gold] upon defeating [gold]Elites[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.flavor: Saps the lifeforce of deadly creatures and synthesizes it into pure bliss.
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.title: Dragon Egg
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.description: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all your card rewards. You can no longer [gold]Skip[/gold] card rewards.
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.flavor: These have not been seen in aeons. Perhaps this is the last one.
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.title: Blighted Mushroom
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp:diff()}[/blue] and lose [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] HP.
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.flavor: The blight festering within this mushroom has made it more potent.
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.title: Double Pendulum
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.description: Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, draw [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] cards. On other turns, draw [blue]{DrawDown}[/blue] less {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.flavor: A toy for those who've lived a thousand lifetimes.
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.title: Mechanical Butterfly
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.descripti: At the start of your turn, EVERYONE gains [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.flavor: Once alive, delicately preserved through slow replacement of parts with gears.
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.title: Sensory Stone
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]3[/blue] Upgraded Colorless Card Rewards.
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.flavor: It illicts memories of the past upon touch.
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.title: Imbalanced Scales
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.description: Upon pickup, add an [gold]All Out[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.flavor: No matter what is put on it, it never levels out.
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.title: Volatile Crystal
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold], remove [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] random cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] random cards.
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.flavor: The legends say it ruptured the ground it was lodged in, creating the seas.
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.title: Entrapped Entropy
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.description: Upon pickup, fill your empty potion slots with [gold]Entropic Brews[/gold]. Using a potion transforms your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.flavor: It constantly shifts, trying to figure some way to break out of its cage.
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.title: Tilt-a-Whirl
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.description: At the end of each turn, play a random card from your [gold]Hand[/gold], then [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.flavor: A miniature theme park ride. The Spire doesn't have these, so it's strange to see a model of one.
BAGELSMOD-MATRYOSHKA_DOLL.title: Matryoshka Doll
BAGELSMOD-MATRYOSHKA_DOLL.description: Whenever you receive a combat reward, get another of the same type. Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Obsession[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-MATRYOSHKA_DOLL.flavor: From your point of view, the dolls inside look just as big as the one outside.
BAGELSMOD-BLOOD_DIAMOND.title: Blood Diamond
BAGELSMOD-BLOOD_DIAMOND.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to [purple]{Cards:diff()}[/purple] cards with [gold]Blood Pact[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-BLOOD_DIAMOND.flavor: The blood of arrogant adventurers, crystallized.
BAGELSMOD-SHAMBLING_VINES.title: Shambling Vines
BAGELSMOD-SHAMBLING_VINES.description: At the start of combat, obtain [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-SHAMBLING_VINES.flavor: Despite being sealed away for a thousand years, these vines writhe as if they had never frozen.
BAGELSMOD-MYSTERIOUS_FRUIT.title: Mysterious Fruit
BAGELSMOD-MYSTERIOUS_FRUIT.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and [blue]{MaxHp:diff()}[/blue] Max HP.
BAGELSMOD-ENCASING_EMBER.title: Encasing Ember
BAGELSMOD-ENCASING_EMBER.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Ancient Quest Cards[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-ENCASING_EMBER.flavor: An emblem from a long forgotten past, sealed away by Nature's wrath.
BAGELSMOD-BUZZING_HIVE.title: Buzzing Hive
BAGELSMOD-BUZZING_HIVE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to [purple]{Cards:diff()}[/purple] cards with [gold]Hive[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-OAK_HEART.title: Oak Heart
BAGELSMOD-OAK_HEART.description: You have [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for each {Amount} HP you are missing.
BAGELSMOD-OAK_HEART.flavor: Encased in bark, it still beats
BAGELSMOD-PHIAL_OF_YOUTH.title: Phial of Youth
BAGELSMOD-PHIAL_OF_YOUTH.description: At the end of combat, heal {Heal:diff()} HP and gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP. Reduce these values by [blue]1[/blue] for each turn taken.
BAGELSMOD-PHIAL_OF_YOUTH.flavor: A small gift from the fabled Fountain.
BAGELSMOD-AXOLOTL_TAIL.title: Axolotl Tail
BAGELSMOD-AXOLOTL_TAIL.description: The first time your HP would be reduced to 0 each combat, heal to [blue]{Heal:diff()}%[/blue] of your Max HP instead.
BAGELSMOD-ROASTED_CHESTNUTS.title: Roasted Chestnuts
BAGELSMOD-ROASTED_CHESTNUTS.description: At the start of your first {RoastLevel} {RoastLevel:plural:turn|turns}, draw {Cards:diff()} additional card and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Can be roasted to increase turn count.
BAGELSMOD-CIRCLET_OF_LIFE.title: Circlet of Life
BAGELSMOD-BURIED_STASH.title: Buried Stash
BAGELSMOD-BURIED_STASH.description: Start combat with {Energy:energyIcons()}. For the first 3 turns, {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} is preserved and you cannot gain ANY other {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
BAGELSMOD-SEDATIVE_SAP.title: Sedative Sap
BAGELSMOD-SEDATIVE_SAP.description: At the start of your turn, apply [gold]Slow[/gold] to enemies with {HPThreshold}% or less of their Max HP.
BAGELSMOD-SEDATIVE_SAP.flavor: A secretion that makes even the strongest foe sleepy
BAGELSMOD-HONEY_POT.title: Honey Pot
BAGELSMOD-HONEY_POT.description: You may add all cards in card rewards to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you add a card, gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP and heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
